answer_1.quote: The task of KG-to-Text generation consists in verbalising the content of a KG.

answer_2.quote: All models were evaluated using the WebNLGtoolkit which includes the SacreBLEU implementation for BLEU, the pyter implementation for TER, and the official implementations of chrF++ and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We use crowd sourcing to filter out badly aligned (graph,text) pairs. ... We then manually annotate the selected data for different types of errors.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked questions including: 'No omission' (does the text express each graph element?), 'No addition' (is all text content in the graph?), 'No unnecessary repetition', and 'Fluency' rated on a scale of 1-5.
